searchText: just a FYI for mainnet users: Nethermind mainnet is only 85gb compared to geth's 350gb. give it a try 😉 I can guarantee that statement isn't true. 🙂 I have to delete my Nethermind DB once a month because it has no pruning and it outgrows my drive. 😢 😮 thanks for letting me know <@!301186049323958275> 🙂 Also nethermind doesn't download historic receipts and blocks by default which is a very selfish approach - if everyone did that we'd lose the chain history. It also causes a lot of problems with eth2 clients which need to read those historic receipts. The configuration can be changed but then it will start using a bunch more disk.
